summary: The second fab of JASM, TSMC's majority-owned Kumamoto venture with Sony Semiconductor Solutions, DENSO and Toyota, built directly east of the first fab in Kikuyo. Announced in February 2024 with operation targeted by the end of 2027, it was backed by about 732 billion yen in Japanese subsidies. Construction was set for late 2024 but the main works began in October 2025, when about US$13.9 billion was reported for a 6nm fab. In 2026 TSMC changed the plan to 3nm, approved by Taiwan's government in March 2026, and now schedules volume production for 2028.

location.note: Directly east of JASM's first fab.

milestones.note: Original target to start construction by the end of 2024.
Main works were due to begin in October 2025 after a siting agreement with Kikuyo town and Kumamoto Prefecture on 24 October; TSMC said in January 2026 that construction had started.
Operation by the end of 2027 was the target in the 2024 plan and again in October 2025.
